team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Crown of the Final Scion: after the equipping character creates a Shield, the active party member's DMG is increased by 10% per 1,000 ATK the wielder has, up to 26% ('on field'); a Hexerei character who is off-field instead gets 50% of that increase ('hexerei off field', 13%). The passive itself is a universal DMG bonus, but it is authored per element so a leaderboard can scope it to the elements its rotation actually deals — enable one condition per element the scored rotation hits. This one grants Pyro DMG Bonus.
R1 Crown of the Final Scion, Hydro share: 26% on field / 13% for an off-field Hexerei character. Enable one condition per element the scored rotation hits.
R1 Crown of the Final Scion, Electro share: 26% on field / 13% for an off-field Hexerei character. Enable one condition per element the scored rotation hits.

R1 Crown of the Final Scion, Geo share: 26% on field / 13% for an off-field Hexerei character. Enable one condition per element the scored rotation hits.

R1 Crown of the Final Scion, Physical share: 26% on field / 13% for an off-field Hexerei character. The passive is a universal DMG bonus, so a rotation with Physical hits (an un-infused Normal Attack string) needs this one alongside its elemental conditions.
